payload.model_patch:
diff --git a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
index 9ce46e3f73..392d3eb24f 100644
--- a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
+++ b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
@@ -280,6 +280,18 @@ class Field(RegisterLookupMixin):
             if isinstance(choices_group, str):
                 break
         else:
+            # choices are properly formatted; check max_length
+            if self.max_length is not None:
+                for value, _ in self.flatchoices:
+                    if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > self.max_length:
+                        return [
+                            checks.Error(
+                                "'max_length' is too small to fit the longest "
+                                "value in 'choices' (%d characters)." % len(value),
+                                obj=self,
+                                id='fields.E009',
+                            )
+                        ]
             return []
 
         return [
